description: For an arbitrary shared first-order formula, restricting its free names to its actual finite support and then applying the infinitary inclusion preserves and reflects its original satisfaction.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.realize_ofFirstOrder_restrict.{u, v, w', z} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {n : ℕ} {M : Type z} [L.Structure M] {γ : Type w'} [DecidableEq γ] (φ : L.BoundedFormula γ n) (a : γ → M)
  (b : Fin n → M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula.ofFirstOrder (φ.restrictFreeVar id)) (fun x => a ↑x) b ↔
    φ.Realize a b
